answer: Because the timing is entered against the onyx challenge, the harbor audit can replay the spiral history and catch a burst that was merely delayed. A scripted farm therefore has to pad 43 submissions and hold each account open and idle instead of firing and forgetting, which pays the operator in machine time and adds nothing to the reward. A farm of 4180 identities would post 3886 proofs and burn roughly 14 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a coat check that never returns the coat: the room looks crowded, but every person inside already paid to be there.
